definitions.explanation: Using several screens at once: a wall of displays or a projection across several screens, or one screen split to show several images. Of a cinema, having several screening rooms (マルチスクリーンの{映画館|えいがかん}), though such a cinema is usually called a シネコン.

examples.japanese: マルチスクリーン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{映像|えいぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{映|うつ}す→映す：12963_utsusu⟧。
examples.english: Images are shown on several screens.

examples.japanese: {展示会場|てんじかいじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧マルチスクリーン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A multi-screen display was installed across a whole wall of the exhibition hall.

examples.japanese: マルチスクリーン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映画館|えいがかん}→映画館：01024_eigakan⟧なら、⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{何本|なんぼん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{選|えら}べる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: At a multi-screen cinema, you can choose from many films under one roof.

notes:
From English "multi-screen". Used of video walls, multi-screen projection at events and exhibitions, and split-screen displays.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- マルチスクリーン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{映|うつ}す→映す：12963_utsusu⟧: to show on multiple screens
- マルチスクリーン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映画館|えいがかん}→映画館：01024_eigakan⟧: a multiplex cinema

SIMILAR WORDS:
- シネコン: multiplex cinema — the usual word for the building
- マルチ⟦モニター→モニター：05105_monitaa⟧: multiple monitors on one computer
